es: Mediar en una reunión de departamento compartido con tacto: exponer una queja, hacer preguntas indirectas, reportar lo dicho y acordar una norma.

vocabulary.es: escuchar a todos hasta el final

teaching.en: I will mediate and chair the meeting; first on the agenda are the chores, and everyone will have two minutes to speak.
teaching.es: Voy a mediar y presidir la reunión; lo primero en el orden del día son las tareas domésticas, y cada uno tendrá dos minutos para hablar.
teaching.explanationEs: Un mediador abre con orden: anuncia su papel, el orden del día (agenda) y los turnos de palabra.
segments: I will mediate and chair the meeting; first on the agenda
are the chores, and everyone will have two minutes to speak.
teaching.audioText: I will mediate and chair the meeting; first on the agenda are the chores, and everyone will have two minutes to speak.

teaching.en: Before we settle anything, I would like to hear everyone out, because a rushed decision rarely keeps the peace.
teaching.es: Antes de resolver nada, me gustaría escuchar a todos hasta el final, porque una decisión precipitada rara vez mantiene la paz.
teaching.explanationEs: Hear someone out = dejar que termine de hablar; settle = zanjar una disputa.
segments: Before we settle anything, I would like to hear everyone
out, because a rushed decision rarely keeps the peace.
teaching.audioText: Before we settle anything, I would like to hear everyone out, because a rushed decision rarely keeps the peace.

teaching.en: I would like to raise something, and I wish we could iron out the small irritations before they grow.
teaching.es: Me gustaría plantear algo, y ojalá pudiéramos limar las pequeñas molestias antes de que crezcan.
teaching.explanationEs: Wish + could expresa un deseo sin presionar; iron out = resolver con calma diferencias pequeñas.
segments: I would like to raise something, and I wish we
could iron out the small irritations before they grow.
teaching.audioText: I would like to raise something, and I wish we could iron out the small irritations before they grow.

teaching.en: To mediate well, you must keep the discussion on track and stop one person from speaking for everyone.
teaching.es: Para mediar bien hay que mantener la discusión encaminada e impedir que una persona hable en nombre de todos.
teaching.explanationEs: Keep the discussion on track = evitar que la conversación se desvíe; el mediador resume y reconduce.
segments: To mediate well, you must keep the discussion on
track and stop one person from speaking for everyone.
teaching.audioText: To mediate well, you must keep the discussion on track and stop one person from speaking for everyone.

teaching.en: I was wondering if we could propose a rota that would help get everyone on board.
teaching.es: Me preguntaba si podríamos proponer un calendario de turnos que ayude a conseguir el apoyo de todos.
teaching.explanationEs: I was wondering if + sujeto + could: petición indirecta; get everyone on board = lograr que todos apoyen.
segments: I was wondering if we could propose a
rota that would help get everyone on board.
teaching.audioText: I was wondering if we could propose a rota that would help get everyone on board.

teaching.en: If only we had agreed on an agenda last month, we might already have a workable solution and a shorter meeting.
teaching.es: Si hubiéramos acordado un orden del día el mes pasado, quizá ya tendríamos una solución viable y una reunión más corta.
teaching.explanationEs: If only + had + participio lamenta algo pasado; a workable solution = una solución que sí se puede aplicar.
segments: If only we had agreed on an agenda last month, we
might already have a workable solution and a shorter meeting.
teaching.audioText: If only we had agreed on an agenda last month, we might already have a workable solution and a shorter meeting.

prompt.es: Elige la frase con la que Sara abre bien la reunión como mediadora.

choices.text: Let me chair the meeting: the chores come first, and everyone has two minutes.
I am only here because nobody else wanted to, so let us get this over quickly.
Before we start, let me say that most of the mess is obviously Leo's fault.

feedback.es: Una mediadora ordena el turno y el orden del día sin culpar a nadie; las otras frases muestran desgana o señalan a un culpable.

hint.es: El mediador ordena turnos y orden del día, sin culpar.

origin.text: Four flatmates are about to meet about the chores. Sara has offered to mediate, and she wants to open the meeting calmly.

prompt.es: Completa: «Antes de decidir, quiere escuchar a todos hasta el final.»

feedback.es: Hear everyone out significa dejar que todos terminen de hablar antes de decidir.

hint.es: Verbo de percepción auditiva; empieza por h.

origin.text: Some of the flatmates have not spoken yet. Before the group settles anything, Sara says that she would like to ___ everyone out.

prompt.es: Ordena: «¿Podría preguntar si todos están de acuerdo con el calendario?»

answer.text: Could I ask whether everyone agrees with the rota

feedback.es: Could I ask whether + sujeto + verbo: la pregunta indirecta mantiene el orden afirmativo.

hint.es: Empieza por Could I ask whether y sigue sin inversión.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige cómo mantiene Sol el orden en la reunión.

choices.text: By cutting Tom off firmly and moving straight to the rota.
By proposing a rota herself and asking everyone to vote at once.
By giving Mar more time than the others because she was the quietest.
By reminding everyone of the turns and summing up what was said.

feedback.es: Sol recuerda los turnos y resume lo dicho por Mar, de modo que nadie se sienta ignorado; no corta a Tom, no impone el calendario ni favorece a nadie.

origin.audio: Sol chaired the meeting calmly. When Tom began to interrupt, she thanked him and reminded him that each person would get two minutes. She then summed up what Mar had said, so that nobody felt ignored, and asked whether anyone wanted to add anything before the group moved on to the rota.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada frase de la reunión con su función.

pairs: Let me chair the meeting; first on the agenda are the chores
I would like to raise something that has bothered me lately
Could I ask whether everyone is happy with Monday?
Mia asked whether we could start a rota

pairs.es: Reportar lo que preguntó otra persona

pairs: Shall we propose a rota from Monday?

feedback.es: Cada frase cumple un paso de la mediación: abrir, plantear, preguntar con tacto, reportar y proponer.

prompt.es: ¿Qué sugiere esta nota sobre el método del mediador?

choices.text: That he wants a workable compromise rather than a winner.
That he favours Leo's flexible task but prefers not to say so yet.
That he will let the flatmates argue until they get tired.
That he thinks a trial would only waste everyone's time.

feedback.es: No elige entre las dos posturas: pide a cada uno qué aceptaría y propone una prueba de dos semanas, buscando un término medio viable.

origin.text: Both sides have a point: Ana wants a fixed cleaning day, and Leo prefers a flexible weekly task. I will not choose between them yet. Instead, I will ask each of them to say what they could live with, and then I'll propose a two-week trial.

prompt.es: Escucha el relato y elige cómo reacciona Leo ante la idea del calendario.

choices.text: Reluctant, and he agrees only because Ana pressed him to accept.
Doubtful at first, but willing to try it for a limited time.
Sceptical throughout, accepting only a rota that is never reviewed.
Bored, agreeing simply to end the meeting sooner.

feedback.es: Leo duda de que alguien cumpla un calendario y no quiere prometer nada, pero acepta probarlo dos semanas con revisión; nadie le presiona y su condición es precisamente la revisión.

origin.audio: Sara called the flat meeting for eight o'clock. She began by saying that she would mediate, not judge, and that first on the agenda were the chores. Carlos raised the kitchen: lately, he said, he had washed other people's plates three times, and he wished someone would notice. Ana replied that she had not realised, and asked whether a rota might help. Leo was not convinced. He said rotas sound fine on paper, but nobody follows them, and he did not want to promise anything. Sara let him finish, then asked if he would try it for two weeks. He agreed, although only after she promised that they would review it at the end of the month.

prompt.es: Escucha de nuevo: ¿qué sugiere el relato sobre el estilo de Sara como mediadora?

choices.text: That she pushes the group to a decision quickly, before doubts can be raised.
That she quietly prefers Carlos's view but hides it to seem neutral.
That she lets people finish and secures a small, short-term promise.
That she gives up on the rota the moment Leo objects.

feedback.es: Sara deja terminar a Leo, propone una prueba corta y promete revisarla: consigue un compromiso pequeño y revisable sin imponer ni tomar partido.

prompt.es: Completa: «Tendrán que limar sus diferencias antes de empezar el calendario.»

feedback.es: Iron out differences es la colocación para resolver con calma desacuerdos concretos.

origin.text: Carlos and Ana see the chores very differently. Before the rota starts, they will have to ___ out their differences, preferably over a cup of tea.

prompt.es: Como mediador, escribe lo que dirías en la reunión, de la apertura al acuerdo.

answer.text: Thanks, everyone, for coming. Let me mediate, and I hope we can settle this calmly. First on the agenda: the chores. Lately, the kitchen has been a mess, and I wish we could keep it tidy together. I am sure nobody wants a problem, and I do not want to blame anyone. I was wondering if everyone could wash their dishes on the same day. Could I ask whether a rota would suit you from Monday? Mia asked me whether we could start a cleaning rota, and I think it is a fair idea. Much as we are all busy, what matters is that each person does a fair share. I would like to hear everyone out before we decide. So, shall we agree that we start the rota on Monday, and that we meet again in two weeks to iron out any problems? Are we all happy with that?

I was wondering if everyone could wash their dishes on the same day. Could I ask whether a rota would suit you from Monday? Mia asked me whether we could start a cleaning rota, and I think it is a fair idea. Much as we are all busy, what matters is that each person does a fair share. I would like to hear everyone out before we decide. So, shall we agree that we start the rota on Monday, and that we meet again in two weeks to iron out any problems? Are we all happy with that?

Good evening, everybody. Let me mediate this meeting, and let us try to settle the chores today. The kitchen has been a mess lately, and I wish we could share the work. I was wondering if each of us could clean one day a week. Could I ask whether Monday would suit everybody? Mia asked whether we could start a cleaning rota, and I think it is a good idea. I understand that some of you are busy, but what matters is that the work is fair, and I would like to hear everyone out first. Shall we propose a rota from Monday, and meet again in two weeks to see how it goes? Are we all happy to agree on that?

feedback.es: Una buena mediación abre con orden, expone la queja con wish, pregunta con tacto, reporta lo que preguntó Mia y cierra con un acuerdo.

origin.text: Reunión en tu departamento compartido. Como mediador, escribe unas 210–270 palabras: abre la reunión; expón una queja suave con wish (la cocina desordenada); haz dos preguntas indirectas (I was wondering if…; Could I ask whether…?); reporta lo que preguntó Mia (asked whether…); y propón un acuerdo: turnos de limpieza desde el lunes.

evidenceGroups: i would like to ask whether

prompt.es: ¿Qué dan a entender estas actas sobre el resultado de la revisión del calendario?

choices.text: That the rota has failed, since one flatmate cannot keep to it.
That Leo has used a clash of classes as an excuse to avoid the rota.
That the mediator is pressing everyone to keep the original days.
That the rota mostly works and needs only a small adjustment.

feedback.es: La mayoría lo ve viable y solo choca un día con las clases de Leo: basta un ajuste pequeño, y el mediador propone cambiar a martes.

origin.text: Minutes of the flat meeting: the group reviewed the chores rota after two weeks. Most of the flatmates felt that it was workable, although Leo pointed out that Thursday clashes with his classes. Ana asked whether the days could be swapped. The mediator suggested trying Tuesday instead and added that nobody should feel forced to accept a change that they cannot keep.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Ojalá pudiéramos mantener la discusión encaminada.»

answer.text: I wish we could keep the discussion on track

feedback.es: Wish + could expresa un deseo sin presionar; keep the discussion on track es la colocación del mediador.

prompt.es: Completa: «Preguntó si el grupo podía hallar una solución viable.»

feedback.es: Find a workable solution es la colocación habitual; reach o come up with también encajan.

origin.text: The mediator asked whether the group could ___ a workable solution by the end of the evening, before everybody went home.
